## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck` pass (frontend)
- [ ] Added or updated tests when touching `backend/app/oracle/`
- [ ] Updated `CLAUDE.md` if a convention or architecture point changed
- [ ] No real API keys, secrets, or `thought_logs/` payloads committed
